Chart Qwen3.5-Plus $2.40 (May 26) matches the 3.5-plus International price, but qwen3.6-plus ($3, from 2026-04-02) and qwen3.7-plus ($1.6, from 2026-05-26) were the newer Plus models by May 26. Archived pages from Apr-Jun 2026 are stale (see gaps).

Chart Qwen3.7-Max $3.75 promo (Jul 26): not found on any snapshot; the page states it lists standard prices only and shows $7.5. Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20260711091745/https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing
Mixed tiers in the chart: Qwen-Max ($6-7.5) and Qwen-Plus ($1.2-2.4) are different tiers; Qwen-Max moved 6.4 -> 6 -> 7.5 -> 6 -> 4.5 while Plus moved 1.2 -> 2.4 -> 3 -> 1.6.
Month rule: price in effect at month end, International (Singapore) page, lowest input-length bracket, non-thinking output where thinking and non-thinking differ.
gaps: Apr, May, Jun 2026: archived copies of the pricing page (2026-04-02, 05-01, 06-01, 06-13) all say 'Last Updated Apr 01, 2026' and omit qwen3.6-plus, qwen3.6/3.7-max and qwen3.6-flash even though their model IDs are dated Apr-Jun 2026. Plus and Flash prices for those months are inferred from the 2026-07-11 snapshot and flagged UNVERIFIED; Max for May-Jun is VERIFIED from secondary coverage.

qwen3.6-max-preview ($1.3 input / $7.8 output, 0-128K) has no launch date on any fetched source; it first appears on the 2026-07-11 snapshot and is not used as a tier point. Launch dates for qwen3.6-plus (2026-04-02) and qwen3.7-max (2026-05-20) are confirmed by secondary coverage (https://docs.apiyi.com/en/news/qwen-3-6-plus-launch.md, https://the-decoder.com/alibaba-launches-qwen3-6-plus-its-third-proprietary-ai-model-in-days/) but those pieces give no price for 3.6-plus.
qwen4-max: release dated 2026-11-16 by the Alibaba press release; its $4.5 output price is read from the live pricing page, not the press release.
Dec 2025: the 2025-12-04 capture of the models page is an empty shell, so Dec 25 prices are carried from Nov 2 and Jan 16.
Alibaba pricing pages carry no release dates; launch months come from dated model IDs and the first snapshot where a model appears.
